selectedBlocks.text: باب في الجنائز ومن كان آخر كلامه لا إله إلا الله
وقيل لوهب بن منبه أليس لا إله إلا الله مفتاح الجنة قال بلى ولكن ليس مفتاح إلا له أسنان فإن جئت بمفتاح له أسنان فتح لك وإلا لم يفتح لك

[1180] حدثنا موسى بن إسماعيل حدثنا مهدي بن ميمون حدثنا واصل الأحدب عن المعرور بن سويد عن أبي ذر رضى الله تعالى عنه قال: قال رسول الله ﷺ: أتاني آت من ربي فأخبرني أو قال بشرني أنه من مات من أمتي لا يشرك بالله شيئا دخل الجنة قلت: وإن زنى وإن سرق قال وإن زنى وإن سرق
[1181] حدثنا عمر بن حفص حدثنا أبي حدثنا الأعمش حدثنا شقيق عن عبد الله رضى الله تعالى عنه قال: قال رسول الله ﷺ: من مات يشرك بالله شيئا دخل النار وقلت: أنا من مات لا يشرك بالله شيئا دخل الجنة
باب الأمر باتباع الجنائز

[1182] حدثنا أبو الوليد حدثنا شعبة عن الأشعث قال: سمعت معاوية بن سويد بن مقرن عن البراء رضى الله تعالى عنه قال أمرنا النبي ﷺ بسبع ونهانا عن سبع أمرنا باتباع الجنائز وعيادة المريض وإجابة الداعي ونصر المظلوم وإبرار القسم ورد السلام وتشميت العاطس ونهانا عن آنية الفضة وخاتم الذهب والحرير والديباج والقسي والإستبرق

[1183] حدثنا محمد حدثنا عمرو بن أبي سلمة عن الأوزاعي قال: أخبرني ابن شهاب قال: أخبرني سعيد بن المسيب أن أبا هريرة رضى الله تعالى عنه قال: سمعت رسول الله ﷺ يقول: حق المسلم على المسلم خمس رد السلام وعيادة المريض واتباع الجنائز وإجابة الدعوة وتشميت العاطس تابعه عبد الرزاق قال: أخبرنا معمر ، ورواه سلامة عن عقيل
باب الدخول على الميت بعد الموت إذا أدرج في كفنه

[1184] حدثنا بشر بن محمد أخبرنا عبد الله قال: أخبرني معمر ويونس عن الزهري قال: أخبرني أبو سلمة أن عائشة رضى الله تعالى عنها زوج النبي ﷺ أخبرته قالت أقبل أبو بكر رضى الله تعالى عنه على فرسه من مسكنه بالسنح حتى نزل فدخل المسجد فلم يكلم الناس حتى دخل على عائشة رضى الله تعالى عنها فتيمم النبي ﷺ وهو مسجى ببرد حبرة فكشف عن وجهه ثم أكب عليه فقبله ثم بكى، فقال بأبي أنت يا نبي الله لا يجمع الله عليك موتتين أما الموتة التي كتبت عليك فقدمتها

[1185] قال أبو سلمة فأخبرني ابن عباس رضى الله تعالى عنهما أن أبا بكر رضى الله تعالى عنه خرج وعمر رضى الله تعالى عنه يكلم الناس، فقال اجلس فأبى، فقال اجلس فأبى فتشهد أبو بكر رضى الله تعالى عنه فمال إليه الناس وتركوا عمر، فقال: أما بعد فمن كان منكم يعبد محمدا ﷺ فإن محمدا ﷺ قد مات ومن كان يعبد الله فإن الله حي لا يموت قال الله تعالى { وما محمد إلا رسول } إلى { الشاكرين } والله لكأن الناس لم يكونوا يعلمون أن الله أنزلها حتى تلاها أبو بكر رضى الله تعالى عنه فتلقاها منه الناس فما يسمع بشر إلا يتلوها

[1186] حدثنا يحيى بن بكير حدثنا الليث عن عقيل عن ابن شهاب قال: أخبرني خارجة بن زيد بن ثابت أن أم العلاء امرأة من الأنصار بايعت النبي ﷺ أخبرته أنه اقتسم المهاجرون قرعة فطار لنا عثمان بن مظعون فأنزلناه في أبياتنا فوجع وجعه الذي توفي فيه فلما توفي وغسل وكفن في أثوابه دخل رسول الله ﷺ فقلت: رحمة الله عليك أبا السائب فشهادتي عليك لقد أكرمك الله، فقال النبي ﷺ وما يدريك أن الله أكرمه فقلت: بأبي أنت يا رسول الله فمن يكرمه الله، فقال: أما هو فقد جاءه اليقين والله إني لأرجو له الخير والله ما أدري وأنا رسول الله ما يفعل بي قالت فوالله لا أزكي أحدا بعده أبدا حدثنا سعيد بن عفير حدثنا الليث مثله، وقال نافع بن يزيد عن عقيل ما يفعل به وتابعه شعيب وعمرو بن دينار ومعمر

[1187] حدثنا محمد بن بشار حدثنا غندر حدثنا شعبة قال: سمعت محمد بن المنكدر قال: سمعت جابر بن عبد الله رضى الله تعالى عنهما قال لما قتل أبي جعلت أكشف الثوب عن وجهه أبكى وينهونني عنه والنبي ﷺ لا ينهاني فجعلت عمتي فاطمة تبكي، فقال النبي ﷺ تبكين أو لا تبكين ما زالت الملائكة تظله بأجنحتها حتى رفعتموه تابعه بن جريج أخبرني ابن المنكدر سمع جابرا رضى الله تعالى عنه
باب الرجل ينعى إلى أهل الميت بنفسه
[1188] حدثنا إسماعيل قال: حدثني مالك عن ابن شهاب عن سعيد بن المسيب عن أبي هريرة رضى الله تعالى عنه أن رسول الله ﷺ نعى النجاشي في اليوم الذي مات فيه خرج إلى المصلى فصف بهم وكبر أربعا

[1189] حدثنا أبو معمر حدثنا عبد الوارث حدثنا أيوب عن حميد بن هلال عن أنس بن مالك رضى الله تعالى عنه قال: قال النبي ﷺ أخذ الراية زيد فأصيب ثم أخذها جعفر فأصيب ثم أخذها عبد الله بن رواحة فأصيب وإن عيني رسول الله ﷺ لتذرفان ثم أخذها خالد بن الوليد من غير إمرة ففتح له
باب الإذن بالجنازة
وقال أبو رافع عن أبي هريرة رضى الله تعالى عنه قال: قال النبي ﷺ ألا آذنتموني

[1190] حدثنا محمد أخبرنا أبو معاوية عن أبي إسحاق الشيباني عن الشعبي عن ابن عباس رضى الله تعالى عنهما قال: مات إنسان كان رسول الله ﷺ يعوده فمات بالليل فدفنوه ليلا فلما أصبح أخبروه، فقال: ما منعكم أن تعلموني قالوا كان الليل فكرهنا وكانت ظلمة أن نشق عليك فأتى قبره فصلى عليه
باب فضل من مات له ولد فاحتسب
وقال الله عز وجل { وبشر الصابرين {
[1191] حدثنا أبو معمر حدثنا عبد الوارث حدثنا عبد العزيز عن أنس رضى الله تعالى عنه قال: قال النبي ﷺ ما من الناس من مسلم يتوفى له ثلاث لم يبلغوا الحنث إلا أدخله الله الجنة بفضل رحمته إياهم

[1192] حدثنا مسلم حدثنا شعبة حدثنا عبد الرحمن بن الأصبهاني عن ذكوان عن أبي سعيد رضى الله تعالى عنه أن النساء قلن للنبي ﷺ اجعل لنا يوما فوعظهن، وقال أيما امرأة مات لها ثلاثة من الولد كانوا لها حجابا من النار قالت امرأة واثنان قال واثنان، وقال شريك عن ابن الأصبهاني حدثني أبو صالح عن أبي سعيد وأبي هريرة رضى الله تعالى عنهما عن النبي ﷺ قال: أبو هريرة لم يبلغوا الحنث

[1193] حدثنا علي حدثنا سفيان قال: سمعت الزهري عن سعيد بن المسيب عن أبي هريرة رضى الله تعالى عنه عن النبي ﷺ قال لا يموت لمسلم ثلاثة من الولد فيلج النار إلا تحلة القسم قال أبو عبد الله { وإن منكم إلا واردها {

segments.arabic: [1180] حدثنا موسى بن إسماعيل حدثنا مهدي بن ميمون حدثنا واصل الأحدب عن المعرور بن سويد عن أبي ذر رضى الله تعالى عنه قال: قال رسول الله ﷺ:
segments.english: Musa ibn Isma‘il related to us. Mahdi ibn Maymun related to us. Wasil al-Ahdab related to us, from al-Ma‘rur ibn Suwayd, from Abu Dharr, may Allah Most High be pleased with him, who said: The Messenger of Allah, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, said:

segments.arabic: أتاني آت من ربي فأخبرني أو قال بشرني أنه من مات من أمتي لا يشرك بالله شيئا دخل الجنة قلت: وإن زنى وإن سرق قال وإن زنى وإن سرق
segments.english: “Someone came to me from my Lord and informed me—or he said, gave me good news—that whoever of my community dies without associating anything with Allah will enter Paradise.” I said, “Even if he has committed unlawful sexual intercourse, and even if he has stolen?” He said, “Even if he has committed unlawful sexual intercourse, and even if he has stolen.”

segments.arabic: [1181] حدثنا عمر بن حفص حدثنا أبي حدثنا الأعمش حدثنا شقيق عن عبد الله رضى الله تعالى عنه قال: قال رسول الله ﷺ:
segments.english: ‘Umar ibn Hafs related to us. My father related to us. Al-A‘mash related to us. Shaqiq related to us, from ‘Abdullah, may Allah Most High be pleased with him, who said: The Messenger of Allah, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, said:

segments.arabic: من مات يشرك بالله شيئا دخل النار
segments.english: “Whoever dies associating anything with Allah will enter the Fire.”

segments.arabic: وقلت: أنا من مات لا يشرك بالله شيئا دخل الجنة
segments.english: And I said: “Whoever dies without associating anything with Allah will enter Paradise.”

comparisons.note: Uses present-tense I say where the selected narrator says I said; retain the past reporting verb and the separate speaker.

notes: Keep the final statement attributed to Abd Allah rather than merging it into the preceding Prophetic saying.
Keep Abdullah’s final And I said separate from the Prophetic quotation. My father remains first-person within Umar ibn Hafs’s route. Do not import the comparison’s extra definitely.

segments.arabic: [1182] حدثنا أبو الوليد حدثنا شعبة عن الأشعث قال: سمعت معاوية بن سويد بن مقرن عن البراء رضى الله تعالى عنه قال
segments.english: Abu al-Walid related to us. Shu‘bah related to us, from al-Ash‘ath, who said: I heard Mu‘awiyah ibn Suwayd ibn Muqarrin, from al-Bara’, may Allah Most High be pleased with him, who said:

segments.arabic: أمرنا النبي ﷺ بسبع ونهانا عن سبع أمرنا باتباع الجنائز وعيادة المريض وإجابة الداعي ونصر المظلوم وإبرار القسم ورد السلام وتشميت العاطس ونهانا عن آنية الفضة وخاتم الذهب والحرير والديباج والقسي والإستبرق
segments.english: The Prophet, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, instructed us to do seven things and forbade us seven. He instructed us to follow funeral processions, visit the sick, answer an invitation, support the wronged, fulfil an oath, return the greeting of peace and invoke blessings on one who sneezes. He forbade us silver vessels, a gold ring, silk, brocade, qassi cloth and thick brocade.

comparisons.note: Supplies our in the oath phrase and appends a textile explanation. The unpossessed Arabic phrase and six named prohibitions remain as selected.

checkedBody: Narrated Al-Bara' bin 'Azib:
Allah's Apostle ordered us to do seven things and forbade us to do other seven. He ordered us:

to follow the funeral procession. to visit the sick, to accept invitations, to help the oppressed, to fulfill the oaths, to return the greeting and to reply to the sneezer: (saying, "May Allah be merciful on you," provided the sneezer says, "All the praises are for Allah,"). He forbade us to use silver utensils and dishes and to wear golden rings, silk (clothes), Dibaj (pure silk cloth), Qissi and Istabraq (two kinds of silk cloths).
comparisons.note: Adds detailed sneezer-response and textile explanations not written in this selected report.

notes: Both inspected prints contain the complete selected occurrence in sequence. Full chain, wording and honorific review remain required before any reader admission.

Keep seven in both introductory counts and exactly the seven commanded actions and six named prohibitions. No seventh prohibition is supplied from a parallel. The unpossessed oath phrase is not narrowed to our oaths. Brocade, qassi cloth and thick brocade render the distinct textile terms; longer explanatory glosses stay outside the report.

The historical print names the Messenger of Allah where selected and modern name the Prophet. No designation change is applied. Selected: «أمرنا النبي ﷺ». brill-1862 (PDF 313): «أمرنا رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم». dar-ibn-kathir-2002 (PDF 300): «أمرنا النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم».

segments.arabic: [1183] حدثنا محمد حدثنا عمرو بن أبي سلمة عن الأوزاعي قال: أخبرني ابن شهاب قال: أخبرني سعيد بن المسيب أن أبا هريرة رضى الله تعالى عنه قال: سمعت رسول الله ﷺ يقول:
segments.english: Muhammad related to us. ‘Amr ibn Abi Salamah related to us, from al-Awza‘i, who said: Ibn Shihab informed me. He said: Sa‘id ibn al-Musayyab informed me that Abu Hurayrah, may Allah Most High be pleased with him, said: I heard the Messenger of Allah, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, say:

segments.arabic: حق المسلم على المسلم خمس رد السلام وعيادة المريض واتباع الجنائز وإجابة الدعوة وتشميت العاطس
segments.english: “The rights of a Muslim over a Muslim are five: returning the greeting of peace, visiting the sick, following funeral processions, answering an invitation and invoking blessings on one who sneezes.”

segments.arabic: تابعه عبد الرزاق قال: أخبرنا معمر ، ورواه سلامة عن عقيل
segments.english: ‘Abd al-Razzaq corroborated it. He said: Ma‘mar informed us. Salamah also related it from ‘Uqayl.

checkedBody: Narrated Abu Huraira:
I heard Allah's Apostle saying, "The rights of a Muslim on the Muslims are to follow the funeral processions, to accept invitation and to reply the sneezer. (see Hadith No 331)
comparisons.note: Retains only three of the five rights: the count, returning greetings, visiting the sick and closing corroborating routes are absent.

notes: Retain all five rights and both closing corroborating routes; the EPUB comparison is materially incomplete.
Retain all five rights, the two informed me verbs and both complete closing routes: Abd al-Razzaq/Mamar and Salamah/Uqayl. The three-item EPUB rendering cannot supply complete wording.

segments.arabic: [1184] حدثنا بشر بن محمد أخبرنا عبد الله قال: أخبرني معمر ويونس عن الزهري قال: أخبرني أبو سلمة أن عائشة رضى الله تعالى عنها زوج النبي ﷺ أخبرته قالت
segments.english: Bishr ibn Muhammad related to us. ‘Abdullah informed us. He said: Ma‘mar and Yunus informed me, from al-Zuhri, who said: Abu Salamah informed me that ‘A’ishah, may Allah Most High be pleased with her, the wife of the Prophet, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, informed him. She said:

segments.arabic: أقبل أبو بكر رضى الله تعالى عنه على فرسه من مسكنه بالسنح حتى نزل فدخل المسجد فلم يكلم الناس حتى دخل على عائشة رضى الله تعالى عنها فتيمم النبي ﷺ وهو مسجى ببرد حبرة فكشف عن وجهه ثم أكب عليه فقبله ثم بكى، فقال بأبي أنت يا نبي الله لا يجمع الله عليك موتتين أما الموتة التي كتبت عليك فقدمتها
segments.english: Abu Bakr, may Allah Most High be pleased with him, came on his horse from his dwelling at al-Sunh. He dismounted and entered the mosque, and did not speak to the people until he went in to ‘A’ishah, may Allah Most High be pleased with her. He went towards the Prophet, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, who was covered with a striped cloak. He uncovered his face, then bent over him and kissed him, then wept. He said, “May my father be your ransom, O Prophet of Allah. Allah will not bring two deaths upon you. As for the death that was decreed for you, you have died it.”

comparisons.note: Adds a mother to the ransom expression where the selected Arabic names only the father. Its bracketed geographical explanation is commentary, not selected source text.

checkedBody: Narrated 'Aisha :

Abu Bakr came riding his horse from his dwelling place in As-Sunh. He got down from it, entered the Mosque and did not speak with anybody till he came to me and went direct to the Prophet, who was covered with a marked blanket. Abu Bakr uncovered his face. He knelt down and kissed him and then started weeping and said, "My father and my mother be sacrificed for you, O Allah's Prophet! Allah will not combine two deaths on you. You have died the death which was written for you."

Narrated Abu Salama from Ibn Abbas : Abu Bakr came out and 'Umar , was addressing the people, and Abu Bakr told him to sit down but 'Umar refused. Abu Bakr again told him to sit down but 'Umar again refused. Then Abu Bakr recited the Tashah-hud (i.e. none has the right to be worshipped but Allah and Muhammad is Allah's Apostle) and the people attended to Abu Bakr and left 'Umar. Abu Bakr said, "Amma ba'du, whoever amongst you worshipped Muhammad, then Muhammad is dead, but whoever worshipped Allah, Allah is alive and will never die. Allah said: 'Muhammad is no more than an Apostle and indeed (many) Apostles have passed away before him ..(up to the) grateful.' " (3.144) (The narrator added, "By Allah, it was as if the people never knew that Allah had revealed this verse before till Abu Bakr recited it and then whoever heard it, started reciting it ")
comparisons.note: The body is shared with the following entry. Adds the mother to a father-only ransom expression and supplies kneeling where the source describes bending over.

notes: The opening account and following Abu Salamah/Ibn Abbas account are separate digital entries; modern print groups their references as 1241–1242.

Keep both Aishah honorifics, the wife attribution, Abu Bakr’s honorific, the two Prophetic honorifics, horse, dwelling, no speech, bending, kiss and weeping. The selected father-only ransom phrase stays unchanged despite both English comparisons and the modern print adding the mother.

The modern print adds and my mother. Selected and historical name only the father. Both English comparisons also add the mother, so their longer wording must not replace this selected occurrence. segments.arabic: [1185] قال أبو سلمة فأخبرني ابن عباس رضى الله تعالى عنهما
segments.english: Abu Salamah said: Ibn ‘Abbas, may Allah Most High be pleased with them both, informed me:

segments.arabic: أن أبا بكر رضى الله تعالى عنه خرج وعمر رضى الله تعالى عنه يكلم الناس، فقال اجلس فأبى، فقال اجلس فأبى فتشهد أبو بكر رضى الله تعالى عنه فمال إليه الناس وتركوا عمر، فقال: أما بعد فمن كان منكم يعبد محمدا ﷺ فإن محمدا ﷺ قد مات ومن كان يعبد الله فإن الله حي لا يموت قال الله تعالى { وما محمد إلا رسول } إلى { الشاكرين }
segments.english: Abu Bakr, may Allah Most High be pleased with him, went out while ‘Umar, may Allah Most High be pleased with him, was speaking to the people. He said, “Sit down,” but he refused. He said, “Sit down,” but he refused. Abu Bakr, may Allah Most High be pleased with him, then pronounced the testimony of faith. The people turned towards him and left ‘Umar. He said, “To proceed: whoever among you used to worship Muhammad, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, Muhammad, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, has died. Whoever used to worship Allah, Allah is living and does not die. Allah Most High said: ‘And Muhammad is only a messenger,’ up to ‘the thankful.’”

segments.arabic: والله لكأن الناس لم يكونوا يعلمون أن الله أنزلها حتى تلاها أبو بكر رضى الله تعالى عنه فتلقاها منه الناس فما يسمع بشر إلا يتلوها
segments.english: By Allah, it was as though the people had not known that Allah had revealed it until Abu Bakr, may Allah Most High be pleased with him, recited it. The people received it from him, and no one was heard but that he was reciting it.

comparisons.note: The final Quran endpoint is expanded beyond the selected single word الشاكرين; do not replace the selected explicit abbreviation with a longer quotation.

checkedBody: Narrated 'Aisha :

Abu Bakr came riding his horse from his dwelling place in As-Sunh. He got down from it, entered the Mosque and did not speak with anybody till he came to me and went direct to the Prophet, who was covered with a marked blanket. Abu Bakr uncovered his face. He knelt down and kissed him and then started weeping and said, "My father and my mother be sacrificed for you, O Allah's Prophet! Allah will not combine two deaths on you. You have died the death which was written for you."

Narrated Abu Salama from Ibn Abbas : Abu Bakr came out and 'Umar , was addressing the people, and Abu Bakr told him to sit down but 'Umar refused. Abu Bakr again told him to sit down but 'Umar again refused. Then Abu Bakr recited the Tashah-hud (i.e. none has the right to be worshipped but Allah and Muhammad is Allah's Apostle) and the people attended to Abu Bakr and left 'Umar. Abu Bakr said, "Amma ba'du, whoever amongst you worshipped Muhammad, then Muhammad is dead, but whoever worshipped Allah, Allah is alive and will never die. Allah said: 'Muhammad is no more than an Apostle and indeed (many) Apostles have passed away before him ..(up to the) grateful.' " (3.144) (The narrator added, "By Allah, it was as if the people never knew that Allah had revealed this verse before till Abu Bakr recited it and then whoever heard it, started reciting it ")

segments.arabic: [1186] حدثنا يحيى بن بكير حدثنا الليث عن عقيل عن ابن شهاب قال: أخبرني خارجة بن زيد بن ثابت أن أم العلاء امرأة من الأنصار بايعت النبي ﷺ أخبرته
segments.english: Yahya ibn Bukayr related to us. Al-Layth related to us, from ‘Uqayl, from Ibn Shihab, who said: Kharijah ibn Zayd ibn Thabit informed me that Umm al-‘Ala’, a woman of the Ansar who had pledged allegiance to the Prophet, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, informed him:

segments.arabic: أنه اقتسم المهاجرون قرعة فطار لنا عثمان بن مظعون فأنزلناه في أبياتنا فوجع وجعه الذي توفي فيه فلما توفي وغسل وكفن في أثوابه دخل رسول الله ﷺ فقلت: رحمة الله عليك أبا السائب فشهادتي عليك لقد أكرمك الله، فقال النبي ﷺ وما يدريك أن الله أكرمه فقلت: بأبي أنت يا رسول الله فمن يكرمه الله،
segments.english: The Emigrants were allotted by drawing lots, and ‘Uthman ibn Maz‘un fell to our lot. We lodged him in our rooms. He then suffered the illness in which he died. When he had died, been washed and been shrouded in his clothes, the Messenger of Allah, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, entered. I said, “Allah’s mercy be upon you, Abu al-Sa’ib. I bear witness concerning you that Allah has indeed honoured you.” The Prophet, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, said, “How do you know that Allah has honoured him?” I said, “May my father be your ransom, O Messenger of Allah. Whom, then, will Allah honour?”

segments.arabic: فقال: أما هو فقد جاءه اليقين والله إني لأرجو له الخير والله ما أدري وأنا رسول الله ما يفعل بي قالت فوالله لا أزكي أحدا بعده أبدا
segments.english: He said, “As for him, certainty has come to him. By Allah, I do hope for good for him. By Allah, I do not know, though I am the Messenger of Allah, what will be done with me.” She said, “By Allah, I will never vouch for anyone after him, ever.”

segments.arabic: حدثنا سعيد بن عفير حدثنا الليث مثله، وقال نافع بن يزيد عن عقيل ما يفعل به وتابعه شعيب وعمرو بن دينار ومعمر
segments.english: Sa‘id ibn ‘Ufayr related to us. Al-Layth related to us the like of it. Nafi‘ ibn Yazid said, from ‘Uqayl: “What will be done with him.” Shu‘ayb, ‘Amr ibn Dinar and Ma‘mar corroborated it.

comparisons.note: The closing alternative is retained only in abbreviated form; the full Said ibn Ufayr route and Nafi ibn Yazid attribution must be recovered from the Arabic, not inferred from this comparison.

checkedBody: Narrated Al-Laith as above.

Keep Umm al-Ala’s introduction and pronoun informed him, the allocation by lot, rooms, illness, washing, clothing, all three Prophetic honorifics, mercy invocation, questions and both oaths. Certainty remains the selected lexical expression. The main with me and later with him readings remain distinct; preserve Said ibn Ufayr/al-Layth, Nafi ibn Yazid/Uqayl and all three corroborators.

segments.arabic: [1187] حدثنا محمد بن بشار حدثنا غندر حدثنا شعبة قال: سمعت محمد بن المنكدر قال: سمعت جابر بن عبد الله رضى الله تعالى عنهما قال
segments.english: Muhammad ibn Bashshar related to us. Ghundar related to us. Shu‘bah related to us. He said: I heard Muhammad ibn al-Munkadir say: I heard Jabir ibn ‘Abdullah, may Allah Most High be pleased with them both, say:

segments.arabic: لما قتل أبي جعلت أكشف الثوب عن وجهه أبكى وينهونني عنه والنبي ﷺ لا ينهاني فجعلت عمتي فاطمة تبكي، فقال النبي ﷺ تبكين أو لا تبكين ما زالت الملائكة تظله بأجنحتها حتى رفعتموه
segments.english: When my father was killed, I began uncovering the cloth from his face, weeping, and they were forbidding me from doing so, but the Prophet, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, did not forbid me. My aunt Fatimah began weeping. The Prophet, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, said, “Whether you weep or do not weep, the angels continued shading him with their wings until you lifted him.”

segments.arabic: تابعه بن جريج أخبرني ابن المنكدر سمع جابرا رضى الله تعالى عنه
segments.english: Ibn Jurayj corroborated it: Ibn al-Munkadir informed me that he heard Jabir, may Allah Most High be pleased with him.

comparisons.note: Its final object becomes a thing removed rather than the person raised; keep the selected pronoun and complete corroborating route.

checkedBody: Narrated Jabir bin 'Abdullah :

When my father was martyred, I lifted the sheet from his face and wept and the people forbade me to do so but the Prophet did not forbid me. Then my aunt Fatima began weeping and the Prophet said, "It is all the same whether you weep or not. The angels were shading him continuously with their wings till you shifted him (from the field). "
comparisons.note: Omits the closing Ibn Jurayj corroboration and supplies a battlefield gloss.

notes: The Ghundar chain link is present in the selected and historical texts but absent in this modern print; retain and disclose the difference.

Keep Ghundar in the selected chain, the weeping, plural prohibition, both Prophetic honorifics, Fatimah’s name and the person lifted at the ending. Retain Ibn Jurayj’s informed me, Ibn al-Munkadir’s hearing and Jabir’s final honorific. No battlefield location is added.

segments.arabic: [1188] حدثنا إسماعيل قال: حدثني مالك عن ابن شهاب عن سعيد بن المسيب عن أبي هريرة رضى الله تعالى عنه

segments.arabic: [1189] حدثنا أبو معمر حدثنا عبد الوارث حدثنا أيوب عن حميد بن هلال عن أنس بن مالك رضى الله تعالى عنه قال:
segments.english: Abu Ma‘mar related to us. ‘Abd al-Warith related to us. Ayyub related to us, from Humayd ibn Hilal, from Anas ibn Malik, may Allah Most High be pleased with him, who said:

segments.arabic: قال النبي ﷺ أخذ الراية زيد فأصيب ثم أخذها جعفر فأصيب ثم أخذها عبد الله بن رواحة فأصيب وإن عيني رسول الله ﷺ لتذرفان ثم أخذها خالد بن الوليد من غير إمرة ففتح له
segments.english: The Prophet, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, said, “Zayd took the banner and was struck down. Then Ja‘far took it and was struck down. Then ‘Abdullah ibn Rawahah took it and was struck down”—and the eyes of the Messenger of Allah, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, were indeed shedding tears—“then Khalid ibn al-Walid took it without being appointed to command, and victory was granted to him.”

checkedBody: Narrated Anas bin Malik:

The Prophet said, "Zaid took over the flag and was martyred. Then it was taken by Jafar who was martyred as well. Then 'Abdullah bin Rawaha took the flag but he too was martyred and at that time the eyes of Allah's Apostle were full of tears. Then Khalid bin Al-Walid took the flag without being nominated as a chief (before hand) and was blessed with victory."
comparisons.note: Renders أصيب as martyred and adds a beforehand explanation to the command appointment. Preserve the selected report’s wording and the narrator’s intervening tear description.

segments.arabic: [1190] حدثنا محمد أخبرنا أبو معاوية عن أبي إسحاق الشيباني عن الشعبي عن ابن عباس رضى الله تعالى عنهما قال:

segments.arabic: مات إنسان كان رسول الله ﷺ يعوده فمات بالليل فدفنوه ليلا فلما أصبح أخبروه، فقال: ما منعكم أن تعلموني قالوا كان الليل فكرهنا وكانت ظلمة أن نشق عليك فأتى قبره فصلى عليه
segments.english: A person whom the Messenger of Allah, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, used to visit died. He died at night, and they buried him at night. In the morning they informed him. He said, “What prevented you from letting me know?” They said, “It was night—and dark—and we disliked causing you hardship.” So he went to his grave and prayed over him.

segments.arabic: [1192] حدثنا مسلم حدثنا شعبة حدثنا عبد الرحمن بن الأصبهاني عن ذكوان عن أبي سعيد رضى الله تعالى عنه
segments.english: Muslim related to us. Shu‘bah related to us. ‘Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Asbahani related to us, from Dhakwan, from Abu Sa‘id, may Allah Most High be pleased with him:

segments.arabic: أن النساء قلن للنبي ﷺ اجعل لنا يوما فوعظهن، وقال أيما امرأة مات لها ثلاثة من الولد كانوا لها حجابا من النار قالت امرأة واثنان قال واثنان،
segments.english: The women said to the Prophet, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, “Set aside a day for us.” He exhorted them and said, “Any woman whose three children die, they will be a barrier for her from the Fire.” A woman said, “And two?” He said, “And two.”

segments.arabic: وقال شريك عن ابن الأصبهاني حدثني أبو صالح عن أبي سعيد وأبي هريرة رضى الله تعالى عنهما عن النبي ﷺ قال: أبو هريرة لم يبلغوا الحنث
segments.english: Sharik said, from Ibn al-Asbahani: Abu Salih related to me, from Abu Sa‘id and Abu Hurayrah, may Allah Most High be pleased with them both, from the Prophet, may Allah bless him and grant him peace. Abu Hurayrah said: “They had not reached puberty.”

comparisons.note: The Sharik / Ibn al-Asbahani / Abu Salih closing route is abridged; preserve every named transmitter and the additional Abu Hurayrah wording.

checkedBody: Narrated Abu Sa'id:

The women requested the Prophet, "Please fix a day for us." So the Prophet preached to them and said, "A woman whose three children died would be screened from the Hell Fire by them," Hearing that, a woman asked, "If two died?" The Prophet replied, "Even two (would screen her from the (Hell) Fire. " And Abu Huraira added, "Those children should be below the age of puberty. "
